assets.name: CHERRY
assets.prompt: Create ONE production-ready 1:1 square transparent PNG icon for a reel in a cute pastel fantasy board-game slot machine. Trickcal Revive compatible rounded squishy toy aesthetic, simple bold silhouette, thick clean dark forest-green outer contour (#386045), cream rim highlight, 3-band cel shading and one broad soft glossy highlight. Front view, centered, object fits within central 74 percent of canvas with generous clear transparent margin on all four sides. Warm gentle palette, very readable at 64px. No background at all, no panel, no medallion, no border around canvas, no ground shadow, no scenery, no characters, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Only the requested isolated symbol. Subject: Two plump glossy rosy-red cherries joined by short dark-green curved stems, ONE tiny fresh green leaf at top. The two fruit bodies have clearly separate outlines and simple cream glints. A recognizable classic slot cherry symbol, no extra fruit.
assets.qa: Accepted: inspected native icon and in-game rendering; no extra subjects or text; corner alpha clear; low-alpha edge noise retained in the original. Source pixels unchanged. In Godot the visible symbol sizes are normalized; effective alpha>32 bounds are recorded.
